diagrams.title: Define the Buyer by the Pain You Fix
diagrams.subtitle: From problem statement to a time-boxed pilot
diagrams.caption: Targeting is built from problems and outcomes, then cut until only accounts with active, budgeted, urgent pain remain.
diagrams.assumptions_note: Steps combine separately reported practices from OGONJO Workbooks, Dan Martell, Hunter and Connor Murray; figures are attributed practitioner claims, not a single measured cohort.
diagrams.note: Sources - OGONJO Workbooks (ZSqgCrydlAo, 4S63IHiDhTk), Dan Martell, Hunter (35H3HVb8ymw), Connor Murray (DBGq--oFsQ8).

stages.label: Problem-Led ICP
stages.detail: Define the buyer by the pain, then run the Five Whys until the emotional reason to act surfaces. One SaaS redefined its ICP and reported +32% conversion and a 20% shorter sales cycle (OGONJO Workbooks).

stages.label: Scorecard Cut
stages.detail: Score 5 to 7 criteria against open deals and disqualify 20 to 30%; a strong ICP shows roughly a 3x win-rate gap between high and low scores (OGONJO Workbooks).

stages.label: Technographic Trim
stages.detail: Trim the universe with technographics, as Dan Martell cut 50,000 accounts to 800.

stages.label: Small-List Segments
stages.detail: Lists of 100 or fewer more than double replies; split a 10,000-lead list into 10 x 1,000 segments, keep each sending box at 50 or fewer per day, and email more than one person per company for almost +50% replies (Hunter).

stages.label: Time-Boxed Pilot
stages.detail: Before any POV, pilot or trial, agree use cases, requirements, people, timeline and success KPIs, and time-box it at 2 or 4 weeks (Connor Murray).

diagrams.title: From Signed NDAs to One Winning Buyer
diagrams.subtitle: The competitive process that sourced deal flow feeds
diagrams.caption: Competition sets the price: a modified middle-market auction narrows signed NDAs to a single winner over four to eight months.
diagrams.assumptions_note: Stage counts are the round-number benchmarks POTOMAC M&A and other bankers describe; conversions are stated as counts, not measured percentages, and real processes vary by deal.
diagrams.note: Source - POTOMAC M&A (8jBQ3jZnNvY): '10 IOIs from 50 NDAs is a really good day'.

stages.label: Signed NDAs
stages.detail: Distribution to 30-40 PE firms plus 5-10 strategics, targeting 30-50 signed NDAs.

stages.label: IOIs
stages.detail: Absolute-price IOIs, not ranges, keep bids comparable.

stages.label: Approved Bidders
stages.detail: Pooled diligence and buyer-only deadlines keep pace.

stages.label: Final Bids
stages.detail: Escrow, R&W insurance, caps and baskets go into the LOI before exclusivity ends the competition.

stages.label: One Winner
stages.detail: The process runs four to eight months end to end.

diagrams.title: Two Enterprise Plays, Measured to the Result
diagrams.subtitle: Re-scored phone list and 1:1 executive experience offers
diagrams.caption: Ronen Pessar's re-scored list turned 53 dials into 21 conversations; Steve Armenti's executive experiences turned 30 contacts into 11 meetings.
diagrams.assumptions_note: Totals and results are the practitioners' reported counts; deduction bars are the arithmetic difference between them. The two plays are separate campaigns shown side by side, not one sequence.
diagrams.note: Sources - Ronen Pessar (dpDcjwreO8o), 39.6% versus 1.6% before re-scoring; Steve Armenti (Mv1ZTzPcy5A), $1.3M result at roughly 10x ROI.

diagrams.title: ABM Performance Markers Practitioners Report
diagrams.subtitle: Click-through, media mix, and conversion lift
diagrams.caption: ABM pays when it runs as a joint sales-and-marketing system on a short, tiered account list, not a lead-volume campaign.
diagrams.assumptions_note: Where a range was quoted without a midpoint, typical is set to the low end. Lifts are single-company results and are not interchangeable benchmarks.
diagrams.note: Sources - LinkedIn for Marketing (Co22pd-mVlk) on terminus and Snowflake; Senator We Run Ads (Jx0muHw5NUY); AdConversion (LbEgZ7SpArs) citing UserGems.

diagrams.title: Four Gates Before Thought Leadership Gets Budget
diagrams.subtitle: Live extraction, real metrics, ad thresholds, podcast vetting
diagrams.caption: Thought leadership pre-sells deals only when the principal's own point of view is extracted live and published consistently.
diagrams.assumptions_note: Gate order is a sequencing convention; each threshold is quoted from the named operator and may differ by account and market.
diagrams.note: Sources - Social-Hire.com (VesCkYBJkFA), ZenPilot (-zNdXXrY9lU), Adam Holmgren (eFSMGI_UK38), AI InterConnect (Ls08sYL9pzQ), Dylan Conroy (yja0j6pWgP0).

nodes.question: Has the ghostwriter extracted the principal's insights on a live call?
nodes.fail_action: Publish nothing under the executive's name; anything else is guessing (Social-Hire.com).

nodes.question: Is reporting built on net-new ICP engagement, qualified leads and MRR rather than likes?
Does the thought leader ad clear 10% CTR, with landing-page clicks at 10% or more of social actions?
Has the paid podcast slot passed the STAGE score and a 30-day posting-activity check?
nodes.pass_next: Fund the slot and send ICP guest invites, which drew 25 to 45% response versus 1 to 3% for cold email (Dylan Conroy).

diagrams.title: One Model, Automated Membership, Checked Outputs
diagrams.subtitle: CRM attribution and AI-assisted sales stack
diagrams.caption: Pick a model, stay consistent, and stop hiding inside blended CAC; campaign membership is marketing's job and should be automated.
diagrams.assumptions_note: Practitioners did not report team sizes; the hub is a function, not a headcount. KPIs are each operator's own thresholds.
diagrams.note: Sources - SalesLabX (JkmlKUCHcmA), Value-First (NZUqq5BtQuU), AI Automation Official (bQPaiBg-cWs), Ambilio (oWWC4Sj-SjA).

center.focus: One consistent attribution model and automated campaign membership, so no rep ever touches it (SalesLabX).

spokes.type: Hidden UTM campaign-ID field plus Flow
spokes.kpi: Zero manual campaign adds; 180-day influence window matched to the real cycle (SalesLabX).
Closed-won near 30% of pipeline; no $60k-$100k deal on a single contact (SalesLabX).

spokes.type: 7 workflows and 80-some fields in HubSpot Pro
spokes.kpi: 12 baseline channels rolling up to 100% for the board (Value-First).

spokes.type: n8n agent with source-line fact checks
spokes.kpi: 4-7 sentence emails, tested on 5-10 leads first; no discounts or dates promised (AI Automation Official, Ambilio).

diagrams.title: Timing Beats Targeting, Targeting Beats Copy
diagrams.subtitle: Reported reply rates by outbound approach
diagrams.total_range: About 1% to 57% reply rates across reported approaches
diagrams.caption: Signal-triggered spearhead campaigns outran wide-net lists carrying near-identical copy.
diagrams.assumptions_note: Each bucket is a separate practitioner's reported result on its own offer and market; buckets are not a controlled test against each other.
diagrams.note: Sources - Hlib Storchak (Iy92NakD7e4) for wide-net, spearhead and hiring-trigger results; Alex Leischow for proof-assets-first.

buckets.label: Narrow Hiring Trigger
buckets.notes: About 1% on a static list to 11% after switching to 'hired head of data in last 90 days', same offer.

buckets.label: Proof-Assets-First Offer
buckets.notes: Leischow claims 57% replies by giving proof assets first.

diagrams.title: Contract the Model, Then Clear the Trip-Wires
diagrams.subtitle: Hybrid pricing and financial-sector guardrails
diagrams.caption: Recurring, risk-shared revenue wins, but finance clients bring hard regulatory trip-wires that have to be cleared on time.
diagrams.assumptions_note: Week sequencing is an ordering convention; practitioners did not prescribe week-by-week timing. Regulatory thresholds are as quoted by the named channels.
diagrams.note: Sources - Rafael Hernandez (XPcFTfp7i8E), Centimillionaire Strategies (N8Z0FPf2yLw), Financial Regulation Courses (CmOezPFI5ew), All Things SPVs (F1OsgcF_bhg).

weeks.title: Contract the Hybrid Retainer
weeks.deliverable: Contract covering ad-spend funding, ad and pixel ownership, the paid-result definition, the fifty-fifty resale split, and credit pricing and expiry.
weeks.gate: Retainer cut from roughly $5K to $2K a month, with pay per delivered result (Rafael Hernandez).

weeks.title: Lock Introductions
weeks.gate: No large allocation from an investor who has never met the manager in person (Centimillionaire Strategies).

weeks.title: Retail Communication Check
weeks.deliverable: Recipient count per piece, with no sales contests or quotas under Reg BI.
weeks.gate: More than 25 retail investors in any 30-calendar-day period requires principal pre-approval (Financial Regulation Courses).

weeks.title: File Form D and Blue Skies
weeks.deliverable: Form D with the date of first sale set to the countersigned close.
weeks.gate: Filed within 15 days of the close (All Things SPVs).
